comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Support has workarounds by reopening from the agent side; portal path still broken for self-serve.

content.text: Support has workarounds by reopening from the agent side; portal path still broken for self-serve.
Customers cannot reopen a closed ticket from the portal within the advertised 24-hour window; the reopen control is disabled or returns an error.
Server policy allows reopen for 24 hours but the portal client uses a stricter closed-at check based on local time without timezone normalization.
Fix the client window calculation, match server policy, and show remaining reopen time clearly on the closed ticket view.
